configurationPurpose: BIFROST Azure PIM access request input. Values in this file describe the person receiving PIM access and the access being requested. They are not PIM activation policy settings; those belong in the PIM .bicepparam file.

_guide._note: This is valid JSON; JSON does not support // or /* */ comments. Use these descriptions to identify field ownership/source.
_guide.pimAccessRequest.requestor: Basic identity details of the person receiving PIM access. Requester/identity team supplies these.
_guide.pimAccessRequest.requestedAccess: PIM access request details: target platform, role, scope, eligibility/assignment request type, duration, and business justification. Requester provides the requested role/scope/justification; deployment operator validates IDs and settings.
_guide.pimAccessRequest.requestedAccess.scope: Target Azure scope. For Subscription scope, provide subscriptionId; for ResourceGroup, provide subscriptionId and resourceGroupName; for Resource, provide resourceId (and the applicable parent scope if required).
_guide.pimAccessRequest.requestMetadata.ticketI: Ticket system's unique internal ID; normally supplied by ticket integration or ticketing system.
_guide.pimAccessRequest.requestMetadata.ticketN: Human-readable ticket number, e.g. INC123456 or REQ123456; supplied by ticket system/requester.
_guide.pimAccessRequest.requestMetadata.ticketS: Ticketing system name, e.g. Jira or ServiceNow; supplied by integration/requester.
_guide.pimAccessRequest.requestMetadata.request: UPN of the person submitting/requesting the access.
_guide.pimAccessRequest.requestMetadata.environ: Environment label used by your team; requester/operator provides it.
_guide.separationOfConcerns: PIM request values are in pimAccessRequest.requestor and pimAccessRequest.requestedAccess. Ticket-specific values are in pimAccessRequest.requestMetadata.ticketId/ticketNumber/ticketSystem. Policy/activation configuration belongs in modules/pim/pim-request.bicepparam, not this JSON.
